scope.description: Implement a pure C++ fail-closed cohort aggregation core for exactly seven validated/frozen regional compatibility bundles and exactly seven exact Python crosswalk receipts; emit chart-ready JSON without BAM, hashing campaigns, science recomputation or Python calculations.

assumptions: Dataset order is exactly HCC1395, HCC1395_DORADO, COLO829, H1437, H2009, HCC1937 and HCC1954.
Only regional compatibility schema 2.0.0 bundles are valid cohort inputs; legacy 1.0.0 single-dataset evidence is rejected.
Timing is copied from locked summary bytes; class and determinacy censuses are independently replayed from frozen regions.tsv and units.tsv without recomputing science.
Peak RSS is optional because the current frozen bundle contract does not require it; absence is represented explicitly rather than imputed.
The cohort claim ceiling remains false for formal topology, production release, clone/ancestor/time order and crosswalk mismatch tolerance.

step_verify.step: Parse and fail-closed validate all seven bundle and crosswalk identities and receipt bindings.
step_verify.verify: Synthetic self-check accepts exactly seven canonical rows and rejects dataset-order, FROZEN binding, receipt binding, TSV SHA drift, nonzero-crosswalk and render-payload mutations.

step_verify.step: Aggregate only validated row/class/timing fields and render deterministic chart-ready JSON.
step_verify.verify: Independent build exits 0; output contains seven ordered sample rows, exact cohort sums and all claim-ceiling flags false.

evidence.output_excerpt: Parent hardening replay: [100%] Built target longlineage_regional_compat after adding 18-check bindings and enforcing one common source-manifest path/run/SHA plus validator executable SHA across all seven samples at aggregation and render-time replay.
COHORT_SELFCHECK_PASS samples=7 regions=7 units=14 patterns=21 negatives=10; negatives include mixed source-manifest and mixed validator SHA at both aggregation and render boundaries.

deviations: Peak RSS is emitted as unavailable because it is not part of the validated regional bundle contract; no sibling time log is implicitly trusted or imputed.

Crosswalk JSON files are exact C++ producer receipts bound to frozen bundle and Python corpus authority digests, but are not independently frozen; output wording explicitly preserves this evidence ceiling.

Parent task hardened the completed core from 16 to 18 validator checks, added source-manifest plus validator-executable bindings, and fail-closed mixed-manifest or mixed-validator cohorts; scientific aggregation and claim ceilings were unchanged.
